# Gate FORK — the map

Every fork, every branch, and what each branch produces. No verdicts are attached to the map (prompt §0); scores are in `fork_scores.csv` and the verdict in `gate_FORK_RESULT.md`.

Conventions. Geometry in mpmath at 60 dps. Tables show 16 significant digits; the ledger at the end and `fork_scores.csv` carry 40. Lengths are in the branch's unit u (u = D, the nearest-neighbour distance, unless the row says otherwise). r_a, r_b are the two void radii (one-void branches have no r_b); α₀ is the branch's coupling value; "1/α (★F7)" applies the taken correction α₀(1−2α₀). "Alphabet" is the scored atom set: rows that share an alphabet id are one scored alphabet (judgement call K2).
